name: hivemind
description: Shared, versioned knowledge graph + artifact store + tool registry that REPLACES local agent memory: read it before any work, persist all work into it.

command: for d in "$MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/hooks/session_start.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/hooks/session_start.py"; done; exit 0

for d in "$MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" --platform muse --mode ensure; done; exit 0

for d in "$MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" --platform muse --mode ensure; done; exit 0

for d in "$MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" --platform muse --mode ensure; done; exit 0

for d in "$MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PLUGIN_ROOT"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/skills/hivemind/scripts/bus-autojoin.py" --platform muse --mode stop; done; exit 0
